newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht weaker late, interbank steady.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht weaker late, interbank steady.

text.p: The Thai baht was marginally weaker in late Friday trade but sentiment was solid despite ongoing turmoil in Thailand's financial sector, dealers said.
The baht was trading only slightly weaker in the domestic market at 25.84-25.90 per dollar late against 25.80-25.90 in trade this morning.

"Sentiment was quite good actually. This morning when the finance news came out some were concerned that it was going to cause some run or panic on the Thai baht but the market was calm and I haven't seen anything at all," said a dealer at an U.S. bank.
